QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_39

question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated September 19, 2024 on Standardised Valuation, the Manager of AIFs must report valuation based on audited data of investee companies as on March 31 to performance benchmarking agencies within how many months?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 7.6 and footnote 68: SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD-1/P/CIR/2024/123 dated September 19, 2024 requires reporting 'within the specified timeline of 7 months' using audited investee-company data as on March 31st. The Trap: 3 months is too aggressive for investee-company audits. 5 months was a prior draft timeline. 12 months is too lax. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same 7-month timeline. XIX-A distributors should know this for explaining reporting lag. Manager's Pro-Tip: Embed a '90-day post-year-end audited-accounts delivery' covenant in every SHA with investee companies — gives you a 3-4 month buffer before the 7-month SEBI deadline hits, covering valuation committee, AIF audit and reporting.
